TarkovTerd - “plenty of special force military units and real world PMC’s prefer some Russian weapons over Nato” that may be true in some military units but from my background and the people I know, I can guarantee to you that most NATO countries with its respective units prefer NATO weapons rather than Russian-type weapons. Russian weapons are decades behind in modernity but they are valid and useful to have for sure.

Edit: in Tarkov, why would USEC’s want to use BEAR-type weaponry rather than their own and vice versa? Surely these PMC’s have had training with their weapons and know how to use it.
